generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's DELTA account of the trillium group (Trilliaceae), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): ovary superior, usually of 3 carpels (3 to 6, rarely 10).

traits.perianth.note: Hutchinson (vol. 2, 1934), families 372 Liliaceae (its false hellebores, death camases and bear grass) and 374 Trilliaceae (Trillium and Paris), which APG joins as Melanthiaceae: perianth of six parts in two whorls, alike in most, the outer green and sepal-like and the inner petal-like in Trillium and Paris; stamens as many as the perianth's parts, usually 6; ovary superior, of 3 carpels; fruit a capsule, or a berry in Paris and many trilliums.
